publisher.match: Match each game to the company that published it.
publisher.odd: Three of these games were published by {value}. Which one wasn't?
publisher.reverse: Which of these games did {value} publish?

rows.label: Minecraft
rows.hook: lets players dig up blocks and build their own worlds in a boundless blocky sandbox

rows.label: Final Fantasy VII Remake
rows.description: 2020 action role-playing video game developed by Square Enix
rows.hook: reimagines a classic role-playing story of an ex-soldier fighting an energy-hungry corporation in a metropolis

rows.label: Metroid Dread
rows.description: 2021 video game developed by MercurySteam and Nintendo
rows.hook: sends a bounty-hunting heroine in a power suit fleeing robotic hunters on a hostile alien planet

rows.label: Fire Emblem: Three Houses
rows.hook: has players teach students at a monastery academy before a war splits their classes apart

rows.label: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
rows.description: 2017 action-adventure video game developed by Nintendo
rows.hook: drops an amnesiac swordsman into a vast open kingdom where he can climb nearly anything and glide anywhere

rows.label: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
rows.hook: lets a hero build wild contraptions and fly through floating islands above a vast realm

rows.label: Among Us
rows.hook: has colorful crewmates fixing a spaceship while hidden impostors sabotage them and vote out suspects

rows.label: Hollow Knight
rows.hook: follows a tiny armored bug exploring a vast hand-drawn underground insect kingdom

rows.label: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
rows.hook: sends a hero who transforms into a wolf between a light world and a shadowy parallel realm

rows.label: Stardew Valley
rows.description: 2016 indie farming simulation role-playing video game
rows.hook: lets a city worker inherit a rundown plot and turn it into a thriving countryside homestead

rows.label: It Takes Two
rows.description: 2021 action-adventure video game developed by Hazelight Studios
rows.hook: forces bickering parents turned into dolls to cooperate through a co-op only adventure to fix their marriage

rows.label: Split Fiction
rows.description: 2025 video game developed by Hazelight Studios
rows.hook: pairs a couple of writers trapped in a machine that plunges them into clashing sci-fi and fantasy worlds

rows.label: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate
rows.hook: packs every fighter in the series into one brawler, with the slogan that everyone is here

rows.label: Kirby and the Forgotten Land
rows.hook: sends a pink puffball into a ruined, overgrown modern world where he can swallow cars whole

rows.label: The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom
rows.hook: lets the usual princess finally play the hero, copying objects to solve puzzles

rows.label: Super Mario Odyssey
rows.hook: sends a mustached plumber to chase a bride-to-be across kingdoms, using a sentient hat to capture enemies

rows.label: Final Fantasy XV
rows.hook: follows a band of princes on a road trip across a kingdom in a car, ending in a battle for a crystal

rows.label: The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword
rows.description: 2011 video game on the Nintendo Wii
rows.hook: was built around motion controls so a blade swings to match the player's arm, in a story set above the clouds

rows.label: Horizon Forbidden West
rows.description: 2022 action role-playing video game developed by Guerrilla Games
rows.hook: sends a red-haired huntress across a ruined American frontier to fight giant machine animals

rows.label: Super Mario Galaxy
rows.hook: sends a plumber through outer space with planet-hopping gravity and spinning on tiny worlds

rows.label: Mario Kart World
rows.hook: debuted alongside a successor console, with 24 racers and a connected map to roam freely

rows.label: Balatro
rows.hook: turns poker hands into a roguelike deckbuilder where wacky joker cards multiply your score

rows.label: Monster Hunter Wilds
rows.hook: sends adventurers through desert and forest ecosystems to track gigantic beasts

rows.label: Street Fighter 6
rows.hook: brings a brawler series to a stylish urban setting, with a hub city you can walk around as your custom avatar

rows.label: Garry's Mod
rows.hook: lets players build contraptions and mess around with physics in a free-form sandbox

rows.label: Portal 2
rows.hook: adds a gel-based puzzle twist and a snarky robot sidekick to a teleport-gun test chamber sequel

rows.label: Donkey Kong Bananza
rows.hook: has a giant ape smash and punch through destructible terrain to chase a lost golden treasure

rows.label: Final Fantasy XIII
rows.hook: follows a pink-haired soldier on the run from a government, on a very linear path through a floating world

rows.label: Pokémon Emerald
rows.hook: sends trainers to a tropical region to stop two opposing teams from awakening legendary weather beasts

rows.label: Super Mario World
rows.description: 1990 platform video game developed by Nintendo
rows.hook: introduced a friendly dinosaur sidekick the plumber can ride, plus a cape that lets him soar

rows.label: Super Mario Bros. Wonder
rows.description: 2023 platform video game developed by Nintendo EPD
rows.hook: turns the plumber into an elephant and has talking flowers chime in as he explores a flower kingdom

rows.label: Tekken 8
rows.description: 2024 fighting game developed by Bandai Namco Studios
rows.hook: brings a long-running martial arts brawler back for a father-and-son feud with an aggressive new style

rows.label: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
rows.hook: lets you build a life on a deserted island, with a raccoon landlord and a loan to pay off

rows.label: Halo 5: Guardians
rows.description: 2015 first-person shooter game developed by 343 Industries
rows.hook: pits a veteran supersoldier against a rival elite soldier in a hunt through a sci-fi shooter saga

rows.label: Mario Kart 8
rows.hook: adds anti-gravity driving, letting racers zoom up walls and along upside-down tracks

rows.label: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening
rows.hook: remakes a handheld adventure of a shipwrecked hero on a dreamlike island, with a toy-like art style

rows.label: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity
rows.description: 2020 hack-and-slash video game developed by Omega Force
rows.hook: shows the century before a famous adventure, as a princess and her allies fight a ghostly disaster

rows.label: Dragon Quest XI
rows.hook: follows a luminary hero in a classic turn-based fantasy tale from a long-running Japanese RPG saga

rows.label: Sonic Frontiers
rows.description: 2022 platform video game developed by Sonic Team
rows.hook: takes a speedy blue hedgehog into an open world on mysterious islands, chasing his lost friends

rows.label: Monster Hunter: World
rows.hook: brought a beast-slaying series to a mass-market audience, with a sprawling living ecosystem to track giants in

rows.label: Wii Sports
rows.hook: came bundled with a console and let people bowl and play tennis by swinging a remote

rows.label: Pokémon Platinum
rows.hook: sends trainers across a snowy northern region to confront a team trying to reshape time and space

rows.label: Super Mario Party Jamboree
rows.hook: packs a huge pile of minigames and lets friends compete for stars on a boardgame-style map

rows.label: Super Smash Bros. Brawl
rows.description: 2008 crossover fighting video game by Nintendo
rows.hook: brought a mascot fighting series online, and added a sprawling adventure mode with a shadowy army

rows.label: Sonic X Shadow Generations
rows.description: 2024 video game developed by Sonic Team
rows.hook: revisits a dark rival hedgehog's story and lets players race through classic and modern levels

rows.label: Monster Hunter Rise
rows.description: 2021 action/RPG video game developed by Capcom
rows.hook: adds a wire-bug grapple and a rideable dog companion for slaying giants in a Japanese-inspired village

rows.label: Pikmin 4
rows.hook: lets a leader of tiny plant-like creatures recruit a rescue dog sidekick to find stranded crew
